title: 第15章 经络穴位图第16章 传授真法玉龙回山
lines: 石壁上的油灯的造型有点奇怪，与叶风记忆里小时候见过的煤油灯有所不同。
青铜材质，造型像是一只在水里游泳的鸭子。
灯芯是从扁嘴里延伸出来的。
油灯并不算大，最多也就能装三斤煤油。
叶风被关进来时，许开便点燃了这盏油灯。
算起来有三天时间了吧，油灯竟然还在燃烧，似乎里面燃烧的灯油是无穷无尽的一般。
叶风走到油灯跟前，打算伸手将油灯从岩壁上取下来。
结果却发现，油灯是牢牢镶刻在岩壁上的。
他只能打开油灯的加油盖，也不知道有多少年没有清洗了，青铜的盖子此刻黑的跟煤球似得。
叶风往里面看了一眼。
只见油灯内部燃烧的并不是自已预想的煤油，而是一种近似固态的东西，呈现出淡白色。
就像是猪油在冬天里凝固的一般。
这种怪异的燃料，燃烧时间极长，估计烧个三五个月，油灯都不会熄灭。
叶风伸出手指，轻轻的抠了一小块，确实是某种油脂凝固后的产物，放在鼻息间嗅了嗅，有一股淡淡的腥臭味。
他将手指尖的灯油轻轻的涂抹在岩壁上，很失望啊，痕迹并不明显，无法被他当做颜料用来画图。
“这鬼地方还能有什么东西可以在岩壁上画图呢？”
叶风放弃了油灯，转头又去寻找别的东西。
石牢里只剩下两样东西了。
角落里盛装粪便的马桶，还有许开送饭时带来的小碟子。
叶风眼珠子一转，想到了主意。
他将碟子里齁咸的咸菜倒掉，啪嗒一声便将其砸碎。
白色的碟子碎裂成几十个碎片，叶风拿起了一枚碎片，用力的在岩壁上划动着。
确实可以留下淡淡的痕迹。
“事实证明，我他娘的确实是个天才！”
叶风大喜，在石牢内手舞足蹈，顺便还跳了几步骑马舞。
搞定了画笔之后，叶风便不再耽搁。
他快速的清理了油灯旁边的一面较为平整的岩壁，用瓷碟碎片画出了一个人类的大致模样，手脚四肢都有。
最后，他便开始闭目冥想，进入內视状态。
然后将內视看到的体内人体构造，一点一点的画在石壁上。
这是一个十分消耗时间的无聊工作。
叶风不断的徘徊在冥想与现实之中。
为了能尽快学习仙法，叶风干劲十足。
不过工程进度却与他的努力显得格格不入。
体内的十二条经络，看似不多，经络却是宛如河道一般弯弯曲曲，这还是主经络。
每一条主经络上，还有密密麻麻的细小经络，而且几乎全部连接着穴道。
人的身体就像是一棵参天大树，经络的主干，密密麻麻的穴道，便是树叶。
叶风只完成不到三分之一，脚步声便再度在走廊通道里响起。
脚步声原本并不大，可是在安静的通道中不断的回响，显得是那么的刺耳。
content_en:
The shape of the oil lamp on the stone wall is a bit strange, and it is different from the kerosene lamps Ye Feng remembered seeing when he was a child.
Made of bronze, it is shaped like a duck swimming in the water.
The wick extends from the flat mouth.
The oil lamp is not very big and can only hold three kilograms of kerosene at most.
When Ye Feng was imprisoned, Xu Kai lit the oil lamp.
Counting three days, the oil lamp was still burning, as if there was endless lamp oil burning inside.
Ye Feng walked to the oil lamp and planned to reach out and take it off the rock wall.
It turned out that the oil lamp was firmly carved into the rock wall.
He could only open the oil lamp's oil cap. He didn't know how many years it had been since it had been cleaned. The bronze cap was now as black as briquettes.
Ye Feng took a look inside.
I saw that what was burning inside the oil lamp was not the kerosene I expected, but something almost solid, showing a pale white color.
It's like lard solidifying in the winter.
This weird fuel has an extremely long burning time. It is estimated that the lamp will not go out even if it burns for three to five months.
Ye Feng stretched out his finger and gently picked out a small piece. It was indeed the product of some kind of solidified grease. He put it between his nose and sniffed it, and there was a faint fishy smell.
He gently smeared the lamp oil on the rock wall with his fingertips. He was disappointed that the traces were not obvious and could not be used as paint for drawing.
"What else is there in this damn place that could be used to draw pictures on the rock wall?"
Ye Feng gave up the oil lamp and turned around to look for something else.
There were only two things left in the stone prison.
In the corner was a toilet filled with feces and a small plate that Xu Kai brought when delivering meals.
Ye Feng rolled his eyes and thought of an idea.
He poured out the salty pickles on the plate and smashed them into pieces.
The white plate shattered into dozens of fragments. Ye Feng picked up a fragment and stroked it hard on the rock wall.
It does leave a light mark.
"It turns out that I am indeed a fucking genius!"
Ye Feng was so happy that he danced in the stone prison and even did a few steps of horse riding dance.
After getting the brush, Ye Feng stopped delaying.
He quickly cleaned up a relatively flat rock wall next to the oil lamp, and used the fragments of a porcelain plate to draw a rough outline of a human being, complete with hands, feet and limbs.
Finally, he began to meditate with his eyes closed and entered a state of inner vision.
Then, the internal human body structure seen from the inside is drawn on the stone wall bit by bit.
This is a boring and time-consuming job.
Ye Feng kept wandering between meditation and reality.
Ye Feng was very motivated in order to learn the immortal method as soon as possible.
However, the progress of the project seemed out of tune with his efforts.
The twelve meridians in the body may not seem to be many, but the meridians are as winding as rivers. This is the main meridian.
On each main meridian, there are also densely packed small meridians, and almost all of them are connected to acupuncture points.
The human body is like a towering tree, with the main trunk of the meridians and densely packed acupoints being the leaves.
Ye Feng only finished less than a third of the time, and the sound of footsteps sounded in the corridor again.
The footsteps were not loud at first, but the constant echo in the quiet passage seemed so harsh.
title_en: Chapter 15 Meridians and Acupoints Map Chapter 16 Teaching the True Dharma to the Jade Dragon Returning to the Mountain
